# pydantic-gepa

> Typed GEPA optimization for Pydantic applications. Define typed examples,
> candidate components, application bindings, and evaluation once; run standard
> GEPA or the experimental Optimize Anything backend without exposing ordinary
> users to Pydantic Evals plumbing.

Documentation: https://vcoderun.github.io/pydantic-gepa/
Repository: https://github.com/vcoderun/pydantic-gepa
Full documentation corpus: https://vcoderun.github.io/pydantic-gepa/llms-full.txt

## Start

- [Home](https://vcoderun.github.io/pydantic-gepa/): package purpose and boundaries
- [Installation](https://vcoderun.github.io/pydantic-gepa/installation/): extras and environment setup
- [First Optimization](https://vcoderun.github.io/pydantic-gepa/getting-started/): complete common API walkthrough
- [Mental Model](https://vcoderun.github.io/pydantic-gepa/concepts/): examples, candidates, injection, evaluation, and results
- [Example Gallery](https://vcoderun.github.io/pydantic-gepa/examples/): runnable repository programs
